calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period
)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- stores only: no web, no training store
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- staff purchases are out of ATV
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY atv DESC;

calls.statement:
WITH date_filter AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT business_date
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) as days_in_report,
       COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as stores_in_report,
       SUM(net_sales_before_returns) as total_net_sales_before_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date IN (SELECT business_date FROM date_filter);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) as stores_with_sales,
       SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_amount
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 4;

SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales s
WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'
  AND s.store_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT s2.store_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s2.store_id < 900
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
      AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  );

SELECT SUM(net_sales_before_returns) as web_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'
  AND store_id = 900;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period
)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900                         -- physical stores only, no web or training store
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag                -- staff purchases excluded from ATV
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'                 -- test articles excluded
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY atv DESC;
